description: Count tokens for text in o200k_base and cl100k_base side by side, plus approximate Claude/Gemini/Llama counts with method notes. OpenAI counts (o200k_base, cl100k_base) are exact for those tokenizers. Claude, Gemini and Llama counts are APPROXIMATE (proxy encoding; real tokenizers differ, often by 10-20%, and newer Claude tokenizers by ~30% or more). Cost estimates use a dated price table (prices_as_of 2026-10-27) and are estimates, not live billing. Stateless: text is not stored or logged; no URL fetching. Max input is 256 KB. A single unbroken run of characters near that cap may hit a CPU timeout (503); normal text at the cap is supported.

text.description: Text (≤256 KB). URLs are not fetched.
